question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 10% per annum is half of the compound interest on a sum of ₹5,000 for 2 years at 10% per annum, interest compounded yearly. What is the sum placed on simple interest?
solution:
Given:

The simple interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 10% per annum is half of the compound interest on a sum of ₹5,000 for 2 years at 10% per annum.

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P
